items.h: The Commanders are slated to waive Tremayne on Tuesday, Nicki Jhabvala of The Washington Post reports.
items.s: Tremayne inked with Washington as an undrafted rookie back in May, and it wouldn't be surprising to see him pop back up on the team's practice squad. The 6-foot-4, 212-pound wideout racked up 74 catches for 1,017 yards and 11 touchdowns in his four seasons at Stanford.
